QuestInfo.name: Strange Teddy Bear
QuestInfo.0: Aily looks upset. Go find out why.
QuestInfo.1: Go let Madame Ming know about the strange Teddy Bears that have been appearing around Fantasy Theme World.
QuestInfo.2: You let Madame Ming know about the strange Teddy Bears.

0.0: Have you seen that creepy teddy bear that keeps wandering around the park? I don't think he works here... He's really giving me the heeby-jeebies. I don't get paid enough to have the heeby-jeebies.
0.1: One of the patrons said he was hanging around the Ghostacular Mansion, but there was white fur on the Gyro Drop too. I gotta go tell Madame Ming about this before she thinks I'm in on it. Or YOU should go tell her while I take a break...

yes.0: Make sure you deliver this message right away. Don't go wandering off!

1.0: What is it, park-goer? Are you coming to tell me how wonderful my park is?

yes.0: A strange bear you say? Does it have a big head and a large, ridiculous belly? Please go back to enjoying the park. My employees should not be troubling you with their wild stories.

npc.0: Why haven't you told Madame Ming about the bear?! He might eat me!
